autograd.description: Owns autograd engine behavior, gradient recording and execution, and Python autograd APIs.

flex_attention.description: Owns FlexAttention kernels, score and mask modification behavior, and FlexAttention integration.

nn.description: Owns neural-network modules, module behavior, and user-facing torch.nn APIs.

testcase_refactoring.description: Owns PRs that make tests reusable across hardware backends, including out-of-tree accelerators: device-generic test conversions (instantiate_device_type_tests, torch.accelerator), hw_classification labels, capability-based gating, and device-generic test infrastructure in torch/testing/_internal. Does not own fixes, skips, or tolerance changes for tests on one specific device.
